title: date encoding and age arithmetic
property: isValidYmd equals an integer civil-calendar reference (D-010 range); utcDateOf, unixOfUtcDate and addDays equal the reference; unixOfUtcDate and addDays throw Error exactly on invalid dates; acceptableTodays holds exactly the UTC dates of now and now - skew, sorted, never a date after today; predicateHolds equals calendar age with the 29 February rule (anniversary on 1 March in common years), ageOn equals completed years

slow.basis: max(1000 ms, 100 x median call time of the first 200 cases); not a timing result

callTimeMs.note: time of the call(s) under test, for the slow-input detector only; not a timing result (untimed series, no quiet-machine protocol)
